source: Upsort test build (dist-test, repo 7a90772) served by scripts/serve-dist.mjs on :4600; pilot folder "Recovered from old phone" (539 files) copied into OPFS and picked via a showDirectoryPicker stand-in (pilot-e2e approach). Save went through the folder (File System Access) path into an OPFS "Pictures" folder.
capture: CDP Page.startScreencast, jpeg q95, everyNthFrame 1, full-res frames (phone: Chromium launched with --force-device-scale-factor=3, otherwise screencast gave 390x844); frames held by timestamp to constant 30 fps; libx264 crf 16 preset slow yuv420p. reducedMotion no-preference; no cursor drawn (headless).

items.name: start-entrance
items.on_screen: Page load of the start screen with its own entrance motion (hero photo fan deals in), then rest. First ~0.5 s is the blank page before first paint; trim it.

items.name: start
items.on_screen: Start screen at rest after the entrance: "Recovered photos, sorted by date.", hero photo fan, "Sort my recovered files" button, privacy line, stepper Scan/Sort/Choose/Save.

items.name: scan
items.on_screen: Press "Sort my recovered files" -> "Checking your files..." with progress bar "Checked N of 539 files" and the three stage ticks -> results screen with the 214 count-up; ~1.5 s hold.

items.name: results
items.on_screen: Results settled: "We found 214 photos and videos."; ledger Files checked 539 / Kept, sorted by date 214 / Set aside, kept safe below 325; "None of your files were deleted or sent anywhere." note; Review button.

items.name: setaside
items.on_screen: Opens "Small preview copies 204", its explanation and "Keep these files", then "See all 204 files" list (real names, e.g. recup_dir.2/f0221440.jpg Photo 10.4 KB) under "These files stay in your recovery folder. Nothing has been deleted."

items.name: review
items.on_screen: "Choose what to save" timeline, eased scroll (~6.5 s) from December 2024 down through the months of 2024 (desktop to ~April 2024, phone to ~February 2024); 214 of 214 selected.

items.name: save
items.on_screen: Press "Save my 214 photos and videos" -> "Where should we save your 214 photos and videos?" (Save to a folder, How your folder will look) ~2.5 s -> Choose a folder (Pictures, via the picker stand-in) -> "Your 214 photos and videos are saved." with tick drawing; ~1.5 s hold. Longer than 8 s: two screens; trim as needed.

items.name: done
items.on_screen: Done screen settled: "Your 214 photos and videos are saved.", 183 days 2019-2024 plus 20 no date, "sorted into a folder for each year and month", Pictures > Upsort photos; desktop also shows the receipt (Saved 214, Couldn't save 0, Sorted into 6 years, 68 months, plus No date (20), Recovery folder Untouched).
